description: Brabant wallon - Voiries is a dataset listed in e-zy BW open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by in BW. Voiries issues du PICC. Source. Coverage: Walloon Brabant. The portal files it under Transports. Its keywords are Voiries, Rues, Noms rues, ICAR. The portal shows 7,520 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2023-10-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-e-zybw-be-portal.
